description: This file defines interfaces for managing the fsmonitor extension in a version control system, including reading, writing, and updating its state within an index, as well as running integration scripts.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor extension from the index, restoring its state if configured.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Fills in the dirty bits for fsmonitor based on the index before it's split for writing.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the state of fsmonitor to the index extension.

methods.name: add_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds the fsmonitor extension to the index.

methods.name: remove_fsmonitor
methods.description: Removes the fsmonitor extension from the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Updates the fsmonitor extension based on current configuration.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the fsmonitor script and updates index states based on the response.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a trivial fsmonitor result.
